verdict_reason: The absolute QPS values require the reference testbed (STATUS.md §6). The rows below are the thesis reference values; a fresh run reproduces the *trend* (monotone latency, monotone degradation, monotone FL-round-time) on any hardware, but the absolute values only on the reference testbed. See REPRODUCIBILITY_CHECKLIST.md §2 and §4 for the full rationale.
note: The tolerance band on p99_ms_estimated is deliberately loose (0.2 ms) to accommodate hardware differences; the trend assertions in table_19_scalability.py are the primary correctness check.
